scope: Read-only installed Gradle bytecode inspection; no acquisition/build/lock/verification execution.
observations: Writer iterates project configurations using internal DeprecatableConfiguration.canSafelyBeResolved rather than a public-all-configuration completeness contract.
Writer obtains ArtifactView files filtered to ModuleComponentIdentifier and explicitly sets lenient=true.
Per-configuration resolution exceptions are caught and logged at DEBUG, then iteration continues.

An emitted verification metadata file and successful bootstrap exit cannot establish absence of unresolved/omitted configurations. Separate acquisition receipts and fail-closed aggregate are required.
